pay.title: Scan, pay. That's it.
pay.sub: No app to download, no sign-up form. Scan the QR on the station, a secure payment page opens in your browser, you pay, and the power bank is released.

steps.title: Scan the QR
steps.text: Point your phone camera at the code on the station. Nothing to install.

steps.title: A secure payment page opens
steps.text: It opens right in your browser. No app, no sign-up.

steps.title: Pay with a tap
steps.text: Apple Pay, Google Pay or a credit card.

steps.title: The power bank is released
steps.text: Take it, charge, and return it at any FULLIN station.

shots.title: Apple Pay, Google Pay or card
shots.text: The payment page opens in your browser, with quick-pay buttons.
shots.alt: FULLIN's secure payment page in a browser: Apple Pay and Google Pay buttons, credit card fields and a pay 12 NIS per hour button

shots.title: Or enter card details
shots.text: The only actual charge is ₪12 per hour. The ₪100 on the screen is a credit-frame guarantee, not a charge, and the payment page has no ₪200 deposit.
shots.alt: The payment page: cardholder name, card number, expiry and CVV fields, and a pay 12 NIS per hour button

vs.text: Scan and pay: ₪12 per hour from the first minute. A free first hour? That's for people who download the app.

pay.terminal: Some stations also have a card terminal. If you pay by card at the station's terminal, a ₪200 deposit is held, not a charge, and it is returned after use according to your credit-card company.
